Viral Testing
Veterinary Viral Testing Services in Omaha, NE
Our veterinarians have access to common viral pathology screening tests, such as FeLV and FIV for cats and parvovirus testing for dogs. This is especially important in very ill animals and those requiring immediate or emergency treatment. Results from these tests help our veterinary specialists make educated decisions on your animal's treatment and allow proper prognosis for pet owners.
